title: Solid rocket motor
description: Fuel and oxidizer are cast together as one solid grain inside the case. There are no tanks, pumps, valves or injector: the case is the combustion chamber. Simple and storable for years, but once lit it burns until the propellant is gone.

reference.engine: Star 48B (Thiokol, now Northrop Grumman), the motor of the PAM-D upper stage

derived.note: throat and exit diameters, grain shape and internal details are representative

reference.note: Case diameter and overall length match the published figures. The thrust shown is the average over the burn. Grain shape, nozzle proportions and internal details are representative.

flow_model.note: Streak speed follows local flow speed on a compressed scale. Gas speed in the bore is a nominal value.

parts.title: Propellant grain
parts.description: Fuel and oxidizer mixed into one rubbery solid and cast inside the case. It burns on the surface of the star-shaped bore, from the inside outward. The shape of the bore sets how much surface burns, and so how the thrust changes over the burn.

parts.title: Insulation
parts.description: Rubber lining that protects the case from the flame once the propellant in front of it has burned away.

parts.title: Motor case
parts.description: Titanium pressure vessel. The whole case is the combustion chamber, so it holds the full chamber pressure and all of the propellant.

parts.title: Attach ring
parts.description: Skirt that bolts the motor to the stage or spacecraft above it. This motor has no gimbal: the stage is spun for stability instead.

parts.title: Igniter
parts.description: A small rocket motor of its own. It fires hot gas down the bore to light the whole inner surface of the grain at once.

parts.title: Igniter bolts
parts.description: Fasten the igniter into the forward opening of the case.

parts.title: Safe-and-arm device
parts.description: Keeps the igniter's firing circuit physically interrupted until launch. Once a solid motor is lit it cannot be shut down or throttled.

parts.title: Nozzle bolts
parts.description: Fasten the nozzle to the aft opening of the case.

parts.title: Nozzle throat assembly
parts.description: The throat is partly sunk into the chamber to save length. It is uncooled: it is made of carbon material that survives the flame for the length of the burn.

parts.title: Exit cone
parts.description: Carbon-composite cone that expands the exhaust to high speed.
